question: What is LOGO in computers?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Programming language**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **LOGO** is a high-level programming language primarily used for educational purposes.
 
• It was created in 1967 by Wally Feurzeig, Seymour Papert, and Cynthia Solomon.
 
• The language is known for its use of **turtle graphics**, where commands for movement and drawing produce line graphics either on screen or with a small robot called a turtle.
 
• LOGO helps in teaching basic programming concepts and computational thinking to young students.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Instruction**

 
 
• An instruction is a single operation of a processor defined by the processor instruction set.
 
• Instructions are the commands that tell a computer what to do.
 
• They are low-level commands used in assembly language programming.
 
 
 
• **Command**
 
 
• A command is an instruction given by a user telling a computer to do something, such as run a program.
 
• Commands are used in command-line interfaces and scripts to perform specific tasks.
 
 
 
• **Programme**
 
 
• A programme is a set of instructions written in a programming language that performs a specific task.
 
• It is a broader term that encompasses various types of software applications.
